Bách(nam) breaks into the archive room, discovers the 6th person file with red ink, encounters Cô Bích who shares her own sister's Rửa story. Intimate, quiet chapter. Linh(nữ) alone at riverside 3am, finds mystery glass of water. Lịch(nữ) arrives, confesses fear of losing Linh's memories. Group gathers at quán — five people, six glasses, empty chair. Bách reveals dạ lan scent connection to 6th person. Tuấn devastated. Linh sees figure across river. decisions.decision: Manga prompt generation approach for LLM output limits
decisions.choice: Incremental trang-by-trang writes: header first, then each trang as separate edit/append step
decisions.rationale: LLM backend cannot emit 300+ lines in a single write. Each prompt file (~180-310 lines) must be built page-by-page. Pattern: write header → append trang 1 → append trang 2 → ... → append final trang + notes.
